Opened [ashcoft/nextcloud-cad-viewer PR #831](https://github.com/ashcoft/nextcloud-cad-viewer/pull/831).

- Source: stable release [`v0.5.0`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/releases/tag/v0.5.0), commit [`5f7d203`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/commit/5f7d2032080e9c0578d0e4cb3b98b2f695f33547).
- Installed 338 scoped files; all 32 existing `.github` files were preserved with zero collisions.
- Validation passed: diff checks, TypeScript build, 756 runtime tests, workflow/docs validation, and shell checks.
- Application tests were skipped because application code was unchanged.

After merge:

1. [Install the Sepo GitHub App](https://github.com/apps/sepo-agent-app/installations/select_target).
2. Add a supported provider secret in [Actions secrets](https://github.com/ashcoft/nextcloud-cad-viewer/settings/secrets/actions).
3. Run [Agent / Onboarding / Check Setup](https://github.com/ashcoft/nextcloud-cad-viewer/actions/workflows/agent-onboarding.yml).
4. Review the resulting `Sepo setup check` issue.
5. Initialize [agent/memory](https://github.com/ashcoft/nextcloud-cad-viewer/actions/workflows/agent-memory-bootstrap.yml) if missing.
6. Optionally initialize [agent/rubrics](https://github.com/ashcoft/nextcloud-cad-viewer/actions/workflows/agent-rubrics-initialization.yml).
